title: Canonical module cohomology boundary
statement: Let X be a ringed space and let H^q(X,-) be module cohomology [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. For a short exact sequence S: 0 \to A \to B \to C \to 0 [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] and q \ge 0, define the connecting map H^q(X,C) \to H^{q+1}(X,A). Concretely, apply derived global sections to the canonical distinguished triangle of S in the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], take its homology-sequence connecting morphism, and transport it through the canonical single-complex/right-derived-functor comparison isomorphisms.
